title: ever MELODÉ|Glitter High-Low Front Side Slit Ruffled V-Neck Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a statement in this shimmering glitter V-neck evening dress, featuring a front side slit and ruffled detailing for a touch of elegance. The high-low hemline adds a modern twist, while the glitter fabric will make you shine and stand out in the crowd. Perfect for a gala or a special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.

seo.description: Ship in 48 hours. Elevate your evening ensemble with this mesmerizing Glitter High-Low Front Side Slit Ruffled V-Neck Evening Dress. The sparkling glitter fabric catches the light at every angle, creating a dazzling effect that is sure to turn heads. The dramatic high-low hemline and front side slit add a touch of allure, while the ruffled V-neckline adds a feminine and elegant touch. Perfect for proms, weddings, and other formal occasions, this dress is sure to make a statement.
